observations.finding: Treated fields have ~40-60 cells/field vs near-confluent DMSO sheet; many cells appear rounded and detached. No direct cell-count z-score provided.

Beta-tubulin (green) markedly brighter and more heterogeneous in treated cells vs diffuse filamentous network in DMSO. Many rounded cells show intense focal/stellate tubulin with high texture on identical contrast. Consistent with tub_mean z=28.5,value 0.706 vs 0.244; tub_std z=27.3,value 0.398 vs 0.108; tub_glcm_contrast z=40.2,value 0.006 vs 0.002

F-actin (red) retained cortically but appears condensed/bright in rounded cells with increased variance and granularity vs even cortical red in DMSO. Consistent with act_std z=17.9,value 0.285 vs 0.073; act_glcm_contrast z=18.1,value 0.004 vs 0.001

DNA (blue) in treated shows condensation and increased intensity: nuclei on composite appear smaller, brighter white-blue where DNA overlaps tubulin/actin, occasional bi-/multi-lobed profiles and irregular contours vs uniform oval pale-blue nuclei in DMSO. Consistent with nuc_dna_mean z=21.0,value 0.814 vs 0.414; nuc_dna_integrated z=16.4,value 524 vs 315; nuc_solidity z=-28.3,value 0.963 vs 0.972 indicating less solid/irregular nuclei

Phenotype of mitotic enrichment: 30-40% rounded bright yellow-white cells (green+red overlap) representing mitotic arrest, with preserved interphase cells showing flatter green tubulin networks. Suggests G2/M block, not general cytotoxic lysis. Not separately quantified.

notable_cells.why: multiple bright monopolar-like rounded cells with intense tubulin foci
clusters of bright rounded cells and reduced confluence vs DMSO

candidate_mechanisms.why: Large increases in tubulin amount, variance and contrast with mitotic accumulation and increased DNA content are classic for microtubule stabilization/polymerization and mitotic arrest at 24h; destabilizers would reduce tubulin signal. Aurora/Eg5 inhibitors can mimic mitotic arrest but strongest signal here is tubulin hyper-intensity/bundling.

report.uncertainty: No separate grayscale channels provided; actin and tubulin overlap judged from composite yellow-white. Cannot reliably distinguish monopolar vs multipolar spindles at this resolution to exclude Eg5/Aurora kinase inhibitors completely.

data.critique:
**Approve.** Protocol call and conclusion agree: Eg5 inhibitors, unanimous 4/4 NSC vote across dose indices 2, 4, 5 and 7 (0.003–1.0 µM), with per-well similarities 0.795–0.873 and a clear mean-similarity gap over the runner-up class in the 10-neighbour list (0.843 vs 0.767).

The microscopist's Microtubule stabilizers suggestion (e5) is the main dissent, but e5 itself notes monopolar-like foci and cannot resolve spindle polarity, while no stabilizer appears among the atlas neighbours.

Acquisitions spanned low to high doses and effectively replicate the phenotype across four independent wells despite each being replicate 1. Probability 0.82 is calibrated given the atlas unanimity offset by the phenotype ambiguity. Budget is exhausted (0/4 left), and no free analysis on existing wells would resolve monopolar vs bipolar spindles beyond the stated resolution limit, so no affordable step could change the call.

data.note: Reflection: Specimen s_7526ba207c (AZ-C, internal BBBC021 code; no PubChem structure/ChEMBL entry) annotated as Eg5 inhibitor was correctly called Eg5 inhibitor (p=0.82, code-scored correct). 4 wells (0.003-1 µM) all showed strong tubulin hyper-intensity (tub_mean z up to 28.5, tub_std z up to 27.3, tub_glcm_contrast z 40.2), increased DNA content (nuc_dna_integrated z ~19) and irregular nuclei (nuc_solidity z -28), with microscopist describing 30-40% rounded bright mitotic cells with focal tubulin consistent with G2/M block. NSC vote was unanimous Eg5 4/4 (final similarity 0.79-0.87), with nearest neighbours from reference Eg5 inhibitor class (mean sim 0.84) outranking microtubule destabilizers (0.77); dose-response showed increasing tubulin with dose (rho +1.0). Literature supports this phenotype: Eg5/KIF11 inhibition induces monopolar spindle formation and mitotic arrest (PMID 19351824 K858 Eg5 inhibitor antitumor; PMID 28392145 Eg5 acetylation mediates mitotic arrest; PMID 34958711 optical control of mitosis with photoswitchable Eg5 inhibitor; PMID 29162464 curcumin Eg5 inhibitory mechanism; PMID 42392246 tubulin/Eg5 modulation inducing mitotic defects). Microtubule stabilizers were considered due to tubulin increase but Atlas vote and lack of microtubule loss (which would favor destabilizers) consistently supported Eg5. Follow-up proposed: high-res pericentrin/α-tubulin/DAPI spindle monopolarity assay vs reference Eg5 and stabilizer controls.

Comparison to reference atlas e6 (3/3 wells) and e11 (4/4 wells) was decisive: NSC 1-NN per-well vote unanimous Eg5 inhibitors with per-well similarities 0.873 (0.03 uM), 0.823 (1.0 uM), 0.795 (0.003 uM), 0.834 (0.1 uM), summed similarity 3.325 vs 0 for runner-up. Review tallies mean similarity gap 0.843 vs 0.767 in 10-neighbour list, supporting 0.82 calibration.

Dose-response trends correctly discriminated vs runner-ups: e7 tub_mean rho=+1.00 (p=0) increase with dose argues against Microtubule destabilizers (which would decrease tubulin intensity) despite k-neighbour split 5/10 Eg5 / 5/10 destabilizers in e6/e11 - the farther neighbours were outweighed by NSC vote. e9 frac_large_nucleus rho=-1.00 (p=0) falling with dose and e12 frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.80 argue against Aurora kinase inhibitors (which would increase large/polyploid nuclei) and favor mitotic arrest. e8 nuc_dna_integrated rho=+0.50 (p=0.67) not significant over 3 doses but absolute z already high.

## Reflection

Verified: correct call - Eg5 inhibitors. Both agent (p=0.82) and protocol NSC 4/4 vote agree with unblinded truth AZ-C.

What was right:

- e5 was the main misleading evidence: as sole dissent supporting stabilizer hypothesis (held at 0.07 in hypothesis_history step 13 vs Eg5 0.82). Visual similarity between stabilizer-induced bundled microtubules and Eg5 monopolar asters at low resolution makes that call understandable. Agent kept stabilizer probability non-zero because tub_mean increase alone does not distinguish stabilizer vs Eg5.
